description: “Basement extension with the installation of skylights to front garden”
decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-1b8a2a74-7fff-d319-59c4-71273e427e51"><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">By reason of it failing to have been demonstrated that all living spaces at basement level would be served by adequate levels of outlook and ventilation, the proposed development would result in a poor and substandard form of accommodation, contrary to policy D6 of the London Plan and policies LP2 and LP17 of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020).</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-e55228e3-7fff-e07c-f6f6-15527677a84d"><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">By reason of the basement exceeding the depth of the front garden by 50 per cent; its construction exacerbated by the <span id="docs-internal-guid-583d528d-7fff-c9d4-1c31-bfdfdc28d095"><span style="font-size: 11pt; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">visibility of the proposed basement roof surface, </span></span>the proposed development would have an unacceptable impact on the character and appearance of the site and wider streetscene and would fail to provide high quality accommodation contrary to policies D1, D3, D4 and D6 of the London Plan, policies LP1 and LP17 of the LP33, and the guidance as contained within the Council’s </span><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-style: italic; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD.</span></span></p>
